en: Job 6

p.src: 1  Then Job answered,

en: Then Job answered,
u.src: 1  Then Job answered,

p.src: 2  “Oh that my anguish were weighed, and all my calamity laid in the balances!

ja: いが秤の上に置かれたらよいのに。
en: “Oh that my anguish were weighed, and all my calamity laid in the balances!
u.src: 2  “Oh that my anguish were weighed, and all my calamity laid in the balances!

p.src: 3  For now it would be heavier than the sand of the seas, therefore my words have been rash.

en: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the seas, therefore my words have been rash.
u.src: 3  For now it would be heavier than the sand of the seas, therefore my words have been rash.

p.src: 4  For the arrows of the Almighty are within me. My spirit drinks up their poison. The terrors of God set themselves in array against me.

ja: の中にあり、 私の霊はその
en: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me. My spirit drinks up their poison. The terrors of God set themselves in array against me.
u.src: 4  For the arrows of the Almighty are within me. My spirit drinks up their poison. The terrors of God set themselves in array against me.

p.src: 5  Does the wild donkey bray when he has grass? Or does the ox low over his fodder?

ja: があるときにいななくだろうか。 牛はその飼葉の前で
en: Does the wild donkey bray when he has grass? Or does the ox low over his fodder?
u.src: 5  Does the wild donkey bray when he has grass? Or does the ox low over his fodder?

p.src: 6  Can that which has no flavor be eaten without salt? Or is there any taste in the white of an egg?

en: Can that which has no flavor be eaten without salt? Or is there any taste in the white of an egg?
u.src: 6  Can that which has no flavor be eaten without salt? Or is there any taste in the white of an egg?

p.src: 7  My soul refuses to touch them. They are as loathsome food to me.

en: My soul refuses to touch them. They are as loathsome food to me.
u.src: 7  My soul refuses to touch them. They are as loathsome food to me.

p.src: 8  “Oh that I might have my request, that God would grant the thing that I long for,

ja: いが聞き入れられ、 私が待ち
えてくださったらよいのに。
en: “Oh that I might have my request, that God would grant the thing that I long for,
u.src: 8  “Oh that I might have my request, that God would grant the thing that I long for,

p.src: 9  even that it would please God to crush me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!

ja: ってくださったらよいのに。
en: even that it would please God to crush me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!
u.src: 9  even that it would please God to crush me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!

p.src: 10  Let it still be my consolation, yes, let me exult in pain that doesn’t spare, that I have not denied the words of the Holy One.

ja: めである。 容赦のない痛みの
を否定しなかったのだから。
en: Let it still be my consolation, yes, let me exult in pain that doesn’t spare, that I have not denied the words of the Holy One.
u.src: 10  Let it still be my consolation, yes, let me exult in pain that doesn’t spare, that I have not denied the words of the Holy One.

p.src: 11  What is my strength, that I should wait? What is my end, that I should be patient?

ja: があって、なお待てるのか。 どんな
わりがあるから、耐え続けられるのか。
en: What is my strength, that I should wait? What is my end, that I should be patient?
u.src: 11  What is my strength, that I should wait? What is my end, that I should be patient?

p.src: 12  Is my strength the strength of stones? Or is my flesh of bronze?

en: Is my strength the strength of stones? Or is my flesh of bronze?
u.src: 12  Is my strength the strength of stones? Or is my flesh of bronze?

p.src: 13  Isn’t it that I have no help in me, that wisdom is driven away from me?

ja: けがなく、 救いの手立ても
から遠ざかったではないか。
en: Isn’t it that I have no help in me, that wisdom is driven away from me?
u.src: 13  Isn’t it that I have no help in me, that wisdom is driven away from me?

p.src: 14  “To him who is ready to faint, kindness should be shown from his friend; even to him who forsakes the fear of the Almighty.

ja: されるべきだ。 たとえ彼が
en: “To him who is ready to faint, kindness should be shown from his friend; even to him who forsakes the fear of the Almighty.
u.src: 14  “To him who is ready to faint, kindness should be shown from his friend; even to him who forsakes the fear of the Almighty.

p.src: 15  My brothers have dealt deceitfully as a brook, as the channel of brooks that pass away;

ja: たちは流れ去る川、 消え失せる川床のように私を
en: My brothers have dealt deceitfully as a brook, as the channel of brooks that pass away;
u.src: 15  My brothers have dealt deceitfully as a brook, as the channel of brooks that pass away;

p.src: 16  which are black by reason of the ice, in which the snow hides itself.

en: which are black by reason of the ice, in which the snow hides itself.
u.src: 16  which are black by reason of the ice, in which the snow hides itself.

p.src: 17  In the dry season, they vanish. When it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.

ja: から干上がってしまう。
en: In the dry season, they vanish. When it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.
u.src: 17  In the dry season, they vanish. When it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.

p.src: 18  The caravans that travel beside them turn away. They go up into the waste, and perish.

en: The caravans that travel beside them turn away. They go up into the waste, and perish.
u.src: 18  The caravans that travel beside them turn away. They go up into the waste, and perish.

p.src: 19  The caravans of Tema looked. The companies of Sheba waited for them.

ja: たちは目を凝らし、 シェバの群れはそれらを
en: The caravans of Tema looked. The companies of Sheba waited for them.
u.src: 19  The caravans of Tema looked. The companies of Sheba waited for them.

p.src: 20  They were distressed because they were confident. They came there, and were confounded.

ja: じ、 そこへ着いて、うろたえた。
en: They were distressed because they were confident. They came there, and were confounded.
u.src: 20  They were distressed because they were confident. They came there, and were confounded.

p.src: 21  For now you are nothing. You see a terror, and are afraid.

ja: や、あなたがたもその川と同じだ。 あなたがたは
en: For now you are nothing. You see a terror, and are afraid.
u.src: 21  For now you are nothing. You see a terror, and are afraid.

p.src: 22  Did I ever say, ‘Give to me’? or, ‘Offer a present for me from your substance’?

ja: 私がこれまで、『私にくれ』と
っただろうか。 あるいは、『あなたの
en: Did I ever say, ‘Give to me’? or, ‘Offer a present for me from your substance’?
u.src: 22  Did I ever say, ‘Give to me’? or, ‘Offer a present for me from your substance’?

p.src: 23  or, ‘Deliver me from the adversary’s hand’? or, ‘Redeem me from the hand of the oppressors’?

ja: してくれ』と。 あるいは、『虐げる
から私を贖い出してくれ』と
en: or, ‘Deliver me from the adversary’s hand’? or, ‘Redeem me from the hand of the oppressors’?
u.src: 23  or, ‘Deliver me from the adversary’s hand’? or, ‘Redeem me from the hand of the oppressors’?

p.src: 24  “Teach me, and I will hold my peace. Cause me to understand my error.

ja: ろう。 私の過ちを私に
en: “Teach me, and I will hold my peace. Cause me to understand my error.
u.src: 24  “Teach me, and I will hold my peace. Cause me to understand my error.

p.src: 25  How forcible are words of uprightness! But your reproof, what does it reprove?

ja: 強いことか。 だが、あなたがたの叱責は
en: How forcible are words of uprightness! But your reproof, what does it reprove?
u.src: 25  How forcible are words of uprightness! But your reproof, what does it reprove?

p.src: 26  Do you intend to reprove words, since the speeches of one who is desperate are as wind?

en: Do you intend to reprove words, since the speeches of one who is desperate are as wind?
u.src: 26  Do you intend to reprove words, since the speeches of one who is desperate are as wind?

p.src: 27  Yes, you would even cast lots for the fatherless, and make merchandise of your friend.

ja: まことに、あなたがたはみなしごをくじにかけ、 自分たちの
en: Yes, you would even cast lots for the fatherless, and make merchandise of your friend.
u.src: 27  Yes, you would even cast lots for the fatherless, and make merchandise of your friend.

p.src: 28  Now therefore be pleased to look at me, for surely I will not lie to your face.

ja: てほしい。 私は決して、あなたがたの面
en: Now therefore be pleased to look at me, for surely I will not lie to your face.
u.src: 28  Now therefore be pleased to look at me, for surely I will not lie to your face.

p.src: 29  Please return. Let there be no injustice. Yes, return again. My cause is righteous.

ja: があってはならない。 もう
してくれ。 私の言い分は正しい。
en: Please return. Let there be no injustice. Yes, return again. My cause is righteous.
u.src: 29  Please return. Let there be no injustice. Yes, return again. My cause is righteous.

p.src: 30  Is there injustice on my tongue? Can’t my taste discern mischievous things?

ja: 正があるだろうか。 この
en: Is there injustice on my tongue? Can’t my taste discern mischievous things?
u.src: 30  Is there injustice on my tongue? Can’t my taste discern mischievous things?
